issues.title: Modal dialog does not trap focus; Tab escapes to page behind
issues.resolution: Added focus-trap to <Dialog>; initial focus moves to the first interactive element and returns to the trigger on close.
issues.retestNote: Tab and Shift+Tab now cycle inside the dialog on Chrome, Firefox and Safari. Esc restores focus to the trigger button.
issues.confirmNote: Verified the fix is applied at the shared Dialog primitive, not per-screen. Approved for release.

issues.title: Patient list stalls above ~2,000 history records
issues.resolution: Server-side pagination on the history endpoint plus row virtualisation in the table.

issues.title: Profile edit silently discards changes on slow connections
issues.resolution: Save button now awaits the PATCH response and surfaces a failure toast instead of optimistically closing the form.
issues.retestNote: Throttled to Slow 3G: save shows a spinner, then persists. Forced 500 shows the error and keeps the form open with values intact.

issues.title: Duplicate clinic name accepted when email differs
issues.resolution: Added a unique index on normalised clinic name.
issues.retestNote: Still reproduces with trailing whitespace and mixed case — 'Shine Dental ' and 'shine dental' both accepted. Normalisation is not applied on the create path.

issues.title: Background geofence check-in does not fire with app force-closed (Android 14)
Prominent disclosure screen missing before location permission prompt
issues.resolution: Added a disclosure screen naming background location use and the check-in purpose before the OS dialog, per Play policy.
issues.retestNote: Disclosure shows on first run before the OS prompt; declining exits the flow cleanly without requesting permission.
issues.confirmNote: Copy checked against the Play Store background-location policy. Cleared for submission.

issues.title: Email OTP accepted after expiry window
issues.resolution: Server now validates the OTP timestamp; expired codes are rejected and the resend cooldown is enforced server-side.
issues.retestNote: Code expired at 5:01 is rejected with a clear message. Resend blocked for 60s. No session created on any failed attempt.

issues.title: Auth token written to AsyncStorage on the web build
Chat attachments fail to download after SignalR reconnect
issues.resolution: Attachment SAS token is refreshed on reconnect instead of reusing the stale connection token.

issues.title: Drag-to-reschedule drops the appointment on the wrong provider column
issues.resolution: Column index was computed from the viewport rather than the scrolled grid. Fixed the offset calculation and added a regression test.
issues.retestNote: Verified at 100%, 125% and 150% zoom, and with the calendar horizontally scrolled. Appointment lands on the intended provider every time.
issues.confirmNote: Regression test reviewed and merged. No further action.

issues.title: Invoice PDF omits the partial-payment line
issues.resolution: PDF template now renders the payments collection, not just the invoice total.

issues.title: Kennitala lookup returns 500 for hyphenated input
issues.resolution: Strip non-digits before calling the national registry.
issues.retestNote: Hyphen handled, but a space-separated kennitala still 500s and the error surfaces as a raw stack trace in the app.

issues.title: Time slots render in UTC instead of clinic timezone
POST_NOTIFICATIONS never requested on Android 13+
issues.resolution: Runtime permission requested on first notification-relevant action rather than at launch.
issues.retestNote: Prompt appears once on Android 13 and 14; denying it degrades gracefully to in-app notifications only.

issues.title: Password reset email link expires immediately in production
Profile contact edits do not persist after app restart
